newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police arrest snake venom smugglers.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police arrest snake venom smugglers.

text.p: Turkish police seized 13 phials of illegally-imported snake venom in the southeastern city of Gaziantep and arrested two men, Anatolian news agency said on Tuesday.
It said the men, an Iranian and a Turk, had smuggled the venom from neighbouring Iran, intending to sell it for $400 per tube. It did not say how big the tubes were.
Snake venom is sometimes used to combat heart disease and blood pressure problems. Homeopaths also administer it in tiny doses to "energise" patients' systems.
